parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, bathroom access is legally protected, and no visitor border/facility restriction is documented — strong traveller-facing positives, corroborated by constitutional/hate-crime climate signals. Survey SOGIE victimisation is at/below regional low end, i.e. background rather than a trans-specific campaign, though harassment/online hatred is above the general population and police reporting is low. The main negative is custody: a 2018 court found one prison knowingly placed seven trans women at high risk of sexual violence in the male section — severity high if detained — but the same court awarded enforceable damages, showing recourse working for trans people. A 2024 study finds continuing institutional lag and residual misgendering, so custody is not reliably identity-based. That unremedied institutional gap, plus workplace hiding/friction, keeps it below 0.95 but well above elevated-risk tiers.
